patthana21.5:1.1: Naappaccayaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sappaccayo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:2.1: Naappaccayaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sappaccayo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:3.1: Naappaccayaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaccayo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:5.1: Nasanidassanaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassano kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:6.1: Nasanidassanaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:7.1: Nasanidassanaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassano abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nasanidassanaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassano abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nasanidassanaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassano abyākato ca anidassano abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. (3) …Hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.5:8.1: Nasappaṭighaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.5:11.1: Naarūpiṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:12.1: Naarūpiṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā arūpī akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:13.1: Narūpiṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca rūpī abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:14.1: Nalokuttaraṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nalokuttaraṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokuttaro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana21.5:15.1: Nalokuttaraṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.5:16.1: Nalokiyaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nalokuttaraṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana21.5:17.1: Nakenaci viññeyyaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kenaci viññeyyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana21.5:18.1: Nakenaci naviññeyyaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kenaci naviññeyyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana21.5:19.1: Nakenaci viññeyyaṃ nakusalañca nakenaci naviññeyyaṃ nakusalañca dhammaṃ paccayā kenaci viññeyyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi. (Sabbattha nava.)
patthana21.5:20.1: Nakenaci viññeyyaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kenaci viññeyyo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakenaci naviññeyyaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kenaci naviññeyyo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana21.5:21.1: Nakenaci viññeyyaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kenaci viññeyyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
